description: Official person ids to the Wikidata item of the person who holds them (CC0), so ids in different systems can be told to be one person or two. Ids Wikidata gives to more than one item are left out. `people` gives each item's name and Wikidata birth and death dates (with the Dictionary of Ulster Biography's where it is more exact), used to keep a candidacy from a person who was under 21 or dead at the time.

also.title: Dictionary of Ulster Biography
also.use: dates only, with the entry linked
